prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait eye animation atlas
Primary request: Create one clean 2-by-2 atlas of the same portrait's upper 64-by-35 face half, based only on the supplied eye reference grid. The full canvas must preserve exact 64:35 aspect ratio and contain four equal cells with no gutters or labels, each showing the complete upper half at the supplied 8x pixel-art scale. Row-major cells: neutral relaxed eyes open; same neutral eyes half-closed; same neutral eyes fully closed; repeat of the open neutral cell. Keep both eyes and both brows fully visible in every cell.
Input images: Image 1 is the only edit reference and supplies the exact face, crop, palette, and native pixel-art anatomy.
Subject: Same adult woman portrait, same facial identity, eye spacing, gaze, iris size, brow length, nose bridge, hair and background as reference.
Style/medium: Muted pixel art with crisp native pixel clusters, matching reference scale and soft pixel-art shading.
Color palette: Preserve warm muted tan skin, olive-brown eye shadows, gray-violet irises and subtle glints, soft brown brows, and subdued contrast. No orange skin, near-black brows, or white flashes.
Constraints: Keep content restricted to the full upper-half eye reference crop in all four cells; do not create or paste a full face. Keep brow shape and stationary orbital creases identical in every phase. Open phase retains source eye geometry and gaze. Half-close by lowering the upper lid vertically over the same eyeball; do not move or shrink iris/glint, shift gaze, or let iris cross lower lid. Fully closed phase conceals iris and sclera completely with a natural lid line. Preserve pixel-grid anatomy, eye spacing, hairline and crop alignment. No new expression: neutral relaxed only. No text, labels, borders, or added elements.
